memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, works as postal worker, reports occasional lower back pain radiating to left leg.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (normal).
falls: no falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 0 regular.
mood: affect stable, denies depression.
carers: none.
goal: "I want to stay pain‑free and keep delivering mail."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
HbA1c 7.8% (target <7.0%).
Fasting plasma glucose 156 mg/dL (70‑130).
Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 22 mg/g (<30).
Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
metformin 500 mg BD after meals.
glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast.
sitagliptin 100 mg OD.
empagliflozin 10 mg OD.
pregabalin 75 mg BD.
diclofenac 50 mg BD after food.
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports improved back pain, still occasional leg tingling after long walks.
cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated (annual due).
falls: no falls; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (polypharmacy) – request Beers review.
mood: good.
carers: none.
goal: "I want fewer leg symptoms and better sugar control."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
HbA1c 7.2% (down from 7.8%).
Fasting plasma glucose 138 mg/dL.
Urine ACR 18 mg/g.
LDL 110 mg/dL (<100 target).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
metformin increased to 850 mg BD.
glimepiride unchanged 1 mg OD.
sitagliptin 100 mg OD.
empagliflozin 10 mg OD.
pregabalin 75 mg BD.
diclofenac 50 mg BD after food.
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports worsening left leg numbness after standing >30 min, mild difficulty climbing stairs.
cognition: unchanged.
falls: one minor slip at home 2 months ago, no injury; gait slightly antalgic left; timed up-and-go 12 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise exercise and supportive footwear.
medicines: 7 regular.
mood: frustrated about pain.
carers: none.
goal: "I want to walk without leg numbness."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Lumbar spine X-ray: mild degenerative changes at L4‑L5, no frank fracture or significant stenosis.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: leg numbness intermittent, manages work with occasional rest breaks.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (borderline) – plan full neuropsych assessment.
falls: no new falls; gait cautious; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline) – continue exercise.
medicines: 7 regular.
mood: anxious about cognition.
carers: none.
goal: "I want to stay sharp and keep working."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
HbA1c 6.9% (at target).
Fasting plasma glucose 124 mg/dL.
Urine ACR 16 mg/g.
LDL 102 mg/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports occasional hypoglycaemic sweats before breakfast, leg symptoms stable.
cognition: unchanged.
falls: none; gait normal; timed up-and-go 10 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (polypharmacy) – continue Beers review.
mood: irritable due to hypos.
carers: none.
goal: "I want to avoid low sugars and stay active."

metformin 850 mg BD.

sitagliptin 100 mg OD.

diclofenac 50 mg BD after food.
